note: How many socket outlets a room of each use needs. They are TYPICAL values to confirm in the norms review (they are not data of a project): only the warehouse perimeter rule comes from a clause of the norm (AEA 90364-7-771), the rest are the usual practice. `basis` says what the count follows: `area` (one outlet per `per_m2`), `perimeter` (one per `per_m` of wall), `length` (one per `per_m` of the longer side) or `fixed` (`min` outlets); `min` is the least a room of that use gets.

office.source: AEA 90364-7-771 (2006), Tabla 771.8.VI (oficinas y locales): una boca cada 9 m² o fracción, mínimo dos

bedroom.source: AEA 90364-7-771 (2006), Tabla 771.8.III (viviendas): tres bocas de 10 a 36 m² (dos si es menor de 10 m²)

living.source: AEA 90364-7-771 (2006), Tabla 771.8.III (viviendas): una boca cada 6 m² o fracción, mínimo dos

kitchen.source: AEA 90364-7-771 (2006), Tabla 771.8.III (viviendas): tres bocas más dos tomacorrientes (grado mínimo y medio)

corridor.source: AEA 90364-7-771 (2006), Tabla 771.8.VI (oficinas y locales) y AEA 90364-7-771 (2006), Tabla 771.8.III (viviendas): una boca cada 5 m de longitud o fracción (en un pasillo angosto, una cada 10 m de perímetro)

warehouse.source: AEA 90364-7-771, rule tomacorrientes.deposito_perimetro (one outlet per 9 m of perimeter, at least 2)

meeting_room.source: AEA 90364-7-771 (2006), Tabla 771.8.VI (oficinas y locales): una boca cada 9 m² o fracción, mínimo dos

private_office.source: AEA 90364-7-771 (2006), Tabla 771.8.VI (oficinas y locales): dos bocas

reception.source: AEA 90364-7-771 (2006), Tabla 771.8.VI (oficinas y locales): una boca cada 18 m² o fracción, mínimo una

mounting.note: Mounting height of the lower edge of the box above the finished floor. Typical limits to verify; the rules they come from are in the AEA rules of sockets.
